title: Comfort Club Covered Repairs: Benefit Grants, Waiting Period, Eligible Lines and Expiry
content:
Benefits administration bulletin on the covered-repair benefit of Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements. Clauses marked as no longer in force are superseded by the current basis and are not applied.

## Grants (in force)
- A tier whose covered-repair benefit per term is above 0.00 receives, at each new or renewal term, a coverage grant equal to that amount.
- Covered-repair benefit is granted only to an agreement in pending or active status.

## Drawing on the benefit (in force)
- Covered-repair benefit is drawn only while the agreement status is active.
- **Waiting period.** A repair is covered only when its service call was booked no earlier than the tier's waiting period in calendar days after the agreement's first covered-repair grant; a call booked earlier is billed normally. The booking time on the service call and the date of the agreement's first coverage grant are the evidence.
- **Covered lines.** Covered lines are the repair parts and repair labor lines of a service call on an enrolled system.
- **Not covered.** Failures that the enrollment inspection recorded as existing, damage from flooding, fire, lightning or freezing of an unheated space, and repairs on equipment that is not enrolled are not covered.

## No longer in force
- The former clause listing diagnostic fees, after-hours premiums, refrigerant, maintenance tune-ups, duct cleaning, thermostat replacement and condensate pump replacement as never covered is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis.
- The former clause applying the member repair discount to the line first, then any protection contract coverage on the same line, with the plan covering what remains, is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis.
- The former clause setting the draw for one service call at the lowest of the remaining covered amount of its covered lines, the per-incident cap and the benefit remaining, allocated to the covered lines in invoice order and posted as one draw per line, is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis.

## Expiry (in force)
Benefit not drawn by the term end expires with the reason "term expiry", and at closure with the reason "agreement closed"; an expiry entry is posted only for a nonzero remainder.

## Waiting period boundary (hypothetical, 30-day waiting period, first grant on 1 March 2025)

| Service call booked | Days after the first grant | Coverable? |
|---|---|---|
| 30 March 2025 | 29 | No — billed normally |
| 31 March 2025 | 30 | Yes |

The waiting period runs from the agreement's first covered-repair grant only; a later renewal grant does not restart it.

superseded_clauses: diagnostic fees, after-hours premiums, refrigerant, maintenance tune-ups, duct cleaning, thermostat replacement and condensate pump replacement are never covered.
The member repair discount is applied to the line first; when a protection contract claim pays part of the same line, that warranty coverage is applied next, and the plan covers what remains.

The draw for one service call is the lowest of the remaining covered amount of its covered lines, covered_repair_per_incident_cap_usd and repair_coverage_remaining, allocated to the covered lines in invoice order and posted as one draw per line it pays.
